infotexts.entitydescription.DeadEyesmagazine: A magazine for a tactical carbine no longer in circulation on Europa’s market, 32 rounds.
infotexts.entitydescription.DeadEyemagazinedeplete: A deadeye carbine magazine with DU bulletsm, 32 rounds.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Admiral_Katana: A melee weapon of Eastern countries on earth, which is very easy to cause bloodshed
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Admiral_Katana_kai: Katana modernized by alien materials, It can cut almost any monster's armor. The high temperature blade will directly heal the wound, so it lose the ability to bleed enemy.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Admiral_Wakizashi: A melee weapon of Eastern countries on earth, shorter than Katana
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Admiral_Wakizashi_k: Wakizashi modernized by alien materials, It can cut almost any monster's armor. The high temperature blade will directly heal the wound, so it lose the ability to bleed enemy.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Blame_harpoongun: The unidentified man-made weapon brought back from the deep sea, the legendary electricity fisher's weapon, the harpoon launched through electromagnetic force has extremely high penetration, It seems to be compatible with the standard batteries we use.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Blame_spear: The legendary electricity fisher's weapon，extremely hard
infotexts.entityname.Wf_Blame_batterycell: Battery for the electricity based harpoon launcher
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Blame_batterycell: The battery of the electricity based harpoon launcher, not compatible with our appliances and chargers.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Blame_G.B.E: Graviton Beam Emitter: An extremely rare unknown weapon found in the deep sea. Its shape is similar to a pistol. It can emit different power of graviton beam according to the residual electricity and generate a gravity explosion attracting surrounding objects at the end of the beam.The beam emitted under any electric quantity has unparalleled power, so it should be used with caution
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_G.B.E_kai: Coalition attempts to transform the G.B.E into universal weapon, which greatly reduces its power, but is compatible with Europa's universal charging devic
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_New_XDS-01: An experimental diving suit made of unidentified cyborg body found in the deep sea. It has better performance than any diving suit circulating on Europa
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_New_XDS-01_Engine: An experimental diving suit components made of unidentified cyborg body found in the deep sea, divers' swimming speed can be greatly increased after being powering on. The principle is unknown
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_debris: An unidentified cyborg body found in the deep sea，The appearance is similar to women. Maybe we can transform it into a diving suit
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Research_Box: A safe deposit box found in the deep sea，You can vaguely see the sign of the coalition in an inconspicuous place
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Research_chip: A XDS-01 design chip found in coalition's safe deposit box, it's designed to destroy the readed data after reading
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Research_Log: A XDS-01 research log found in coalition's safe deposit box，the content is damaged and cannot be read, but the coalition may buy it at a high price
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_pucs: Experimental Pressure Stabilized PUCS: An PUCS using experimental technology to replace heavy shell with pressure stabilize, has better vision and mobility than ordinary PUCS.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_pucs_R: Targeted improved EPSP, using ballistic fiber to strengthen the defense against attacks.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_pucs_B: Targeted improved EPSP, using ballistic fiber and titanium aluminum to strengthen the defense. While maintaining excellent burn defense, it has the defense and pressure resistance of the standard abyss diving suit.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_pucs_D: Targeted improved EPSP, It uses low visibility coating and strengthens the defense against human weapons. It's also Equipped with small thrusters for rapid movement of warfighters outside the operational area.
infotexts.Prisonerequipconfirmation: Do you wanna lock youself in the strait jacket？
infotexts.entitydescription.machinepistolmagazined: A machine pistol magazine filled with depleted fuel bullet,40 rounds.
infotexts.entitydescription.Mudraptorarmor: A armor made from Mudraptor's shell,provide less protection but more maneuverability and protection area.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Admiral_Katana_Mudr: A katana reinforced by mudraptor materials, can do much more damage and stun, need two hand to use.
infotexts.entitydescription.New_XDS-01: A cyberware unit reverse-engineered from an unknown cyborg specimen recovered from the deep. It enables full-body cyberization, though with an apparent lack of a reversal protocol.
infotexts.entitydescription.New_XDS-01_B: A cyberware unit reverse-engineered from an unknown cyborg specimen recovered from the deep. It enables full-body cyberization, though with an apparent lack of a reversal protocol.
infotexts.entitydescription.New_XDS-01_Core: A cyberware accessory reverse-engineered from the unknown cyborg specimen. Once an integrated part of its original host, it has been repurposed into a wearable accessory by the coalition.
infotexts.entitydescription.XDS_Remains: An unidentified cyborg specimen, recovered from the depths, appears to have been abandoned for centuries. Unlike any known alien artifact, its design suggests a feminine form.
infotexts.XDSequipconfirmation: Do you wanna cyberize yourself? It will change your appearance and it can't reverse.
infotexts.entitydescription.Xds_RepairKit: A repair kit reverse-engineered from the unknown cyborg specimen by the coalition, can repair the XDS-01 cyborg.
infotexts.entitydescription.XDS-01_ChargingPod: A maintenance pod reverse-engineered from the unknown cyborg specimen by the coalition, the XDS-01 cyborg can only recharge in the pod.
infotexts.entitydescription.Xds_Excitant: An emergency charging equipment reverse-engineered from the unknown cyborg specimen by the coalition, An injection can grant XDS-01 a fleeting energy boost, but it comes at a cost—a crippling buildup of waste heat that scorches its systems from within.
infotexts.entitydescription.Wf_Research_chip_B: A XDS-01 maintenance pod design chip found in coalition's safe deposit box, it's designed to destroy the readed data after reading.
